**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is helping their best friend, Emily, plan her wedding.

[FACT] User is looking for decoration ideas for the wedding.

[PREFERENCE] User prefers decoration ideas that blend rural and elegant elements, focusing on natural materials and earthy tones.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested several centerpiece ideas: wildflower bouquets in mercury glass vases or wooden planters, pampas grass and candles in lanterns, river rock and greenery in wooden or stone vessels, vintage mason jars with seasonal flowers, and wood slices with votive candles.

[USER] User requested suggestions for wedding favors that fit the rustic-elegant theme, incorporating natural elements or handmade items.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested several wedding favor ideas: seed bombs, pinecone favors, river rock candles, herb planters, dried flower crowns, hand-painted wooden coasters, macrame plant hangers, lavender sachets, homemade cookies, handmade soap or candles, personalized wooden spoons, mini terrariums, wax paper cones, and nature-inspired tea blends.

[USER] User requested more affordable favor options under $5 per favor.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided budget-friendly favor ideas: wildflower seed packets, small potted herbs, homemade cookies or treats, dried lavender buds, hand-tied twine favors, mini pinecones, small candles, and nature-inspired tea bags.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested packaging ideas for wildflower seed packets: kraft paper envelopes, brown paper bags, muslin bags, and recycled paper.
